title: Diana Pasulka calls Chris Bledsoe a modern Paul Bennewitz

tellings.quote: So uh but Dian Pasoka came out and she said I think Chris Bledsoe is a modern Paul Benowitz.

plain: The religion scholar Diana Pasulka has compared Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who reports long-running encounters with strange beings and lights, to Paul Bennewitz, the man at the center of a 2025 episode titled "'Aliens' Drove This Man Insane!". Michels repeats this himself, saying Pasulka "came out and she said I think Chris Bledsoe is a modern Paul Bennewitz." The comparison would mean Bledsoe's story could follow the same troubled path as the earlier man's.
